output_list.criticism: The mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, which can lead to integer overflow.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount of tokens purchased is determined by the value of the buy price.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount of tokens sold is determined by the value of the sell price.
The transfer function has an integer overflow where the amount of tokens transferred is determined by the value of the balance of the sender.
